### ⚠️ Requires [Provi's Origins](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki) to be installed! ⚠️

## Has Team

---

[Entity Condition Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Entity-Conditions)

Checks whether or not the entity has a [scoreboard team](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Scoreboard#Teams).

---

## Examples
```json
"entity_condition": {
    "type": "proviorigins:has_team"
}
```
This example will return true if the entity has a scoreboard team.

x-intellij-html-description:
Entity Condition Type

Checks whether or not the entity has a scoreboard team.

Type ID: proviorigins:has_team

Note
Scoreboard teams are serverside only under normal circumstances.

Fields

None

Examples

"entity_condition": {
    "type": "proviorigins:has_team"
}

This example will return true if the entity has a scoreboard team.
